name: query target choice
grammar:
%rule use(@X) $x:_ %conditions $x.matches(@X)
%rule text = use(a | b)
%rule a "a"
%rule b "b"

name: body target choice
grammar:
%rule use(@X) @X
%rule text = use(a | b)
%rule a "a"
%rule b "b"

name: rebind public name
grammar:
%rule use(@X) @X
%rule text item
%rule item = use("a")
%extend-rule item "b"
%redefine-rule item = use("c")

name: body choice as query target
grammar:
%rule use(@X) $x:_ %conditions $x.matches(@X)
%rule text use((a | b))
%rule a "a"
%rule b "b"

name: duplicate instance public names
grammar:
%rule use(@X) @X
%rule a = use("a")
%rule b = use("a")
%rule text a

name: public edit before binding
grammar:
%rule use(@X) @X
%extend-rule item "b"
%rule item = use("a")
%rule text item

name: a comment after a reference remains layout
space before a group is not a call
a target list splices between surrounding entries
grammar:
%rule use(@X) $x:_ %conditions $x.matches(a | @X | d)
%rule text = use(b | c)
%rule a "a"
%rule b "b"
%rule c "c"
%rule d "d"

name: a requirement list splices between surrounding entries
a parameter supplies a tested pattern atom
a parameter supplies a range endpoint
an elidable head cannot be a grouped parameter
a target choice cannot replace a term
grammar:
%rule atom(@X) "a" :: @X
%rule text = atom(a | b)
%rule a "a"
%rule b "b"

name: a sequence cannot replace a pattern atom
a string concatenation cannot replace a value test
a parameter remains a pattern operand under union
a parameter remains a pattern operand under intersection
a parameter remains a pattern operand under difference
a family remains a pattern operand under union
an exact call remains a pattern operand under intersection
a ranked body argument retains its seal
an uncalled template rejects an unknown dependent method
an ordinary definition replaced by a binding still validates constants
canonical names group a compound method receiver
recursive parenthesized parameter keeps a finite key
family matches named and locally redefined instances
uncalled family matches nothing and discovers nothing
tested symbol cannot splice its filter requirements
grammar:
%rule filtered(@X) a<@X>
%rule text filtered(KU<Accent>)
%rule a A

name: tested symbol remains a body argument
tags rejects a target choice argument
grammar:
%rule atom(@X) @X
%rule use(@X) $a:A :: $a.tags(@X)
%rule text use(a | b)
%rule a A
%rule b B

name: without-elision-except rejects a target choice argument
grammar:
%rule atom(@X) @X
%rule use(@X) $a:A %conditions $a.without-elision-except(@X).matches(A)
%rule text use(a | b)
%rule a A
%rule b B

name: tags accepts one nominal rule argument
grammar:
%rule atom(@X) @X
%rule use(@X) $a:A :: $a.tags(@X)
%rule text use(a)
%rule a A
%rule b B

name: tags accepts one exact instance argument
grammar:
%rule atom(@X) @X
%rule use(@X) $a:A :: $a.tags(@X)
%rule text use(atom("a"))
%rule a A
%rule b B

name: without-elision-except accepts one nominal rule argument
grammar:

%rule a A
%rule b B

name: without-elision-except accepts one exact instance argument
grammar:
%rule atom(@X) @X
%rule use(@X) $a:A %conditions $a.without-elision-except(@X).matches(A)
%rule text use(atom("a"))
%rule a A
%rule b B
